question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T2.surname AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC) AS __r FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: What are the surnames of all drivers tied for the fastest lap time in the second qualifying period (Q2) of raceId 19?
d.sql: SELECT d.surname FROM drivers AS d JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 19 AND q2 IS NOT NULL)

b.request: Return the surnames of all drivers whose q2 time equals the minimum q2 time among qualifying entries for raceId
b.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.surname FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2.q2) FROM qualifying AS q2 WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId)

c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.surname FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 19)
